name: viratrend
description: ViraTrend — plataforma de descoberta e curadoria de produtos (afiliados).

scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @viratrend/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @viratrend/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @viratrend/api && npm run build -w @viratrend/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
